images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production modeling reference for the first modular player-character base body in OpenMMO, for Meshy image-to-3D and a shared humanoid animation rig.
Primary request: create ONE original adult human male, approximately 27 years old, in a precise front-facing neutral symmetrical A-pose. Moderately athletic everyday adventurer build, lean and believable rather than bodybuilder, natural roughly seven-and-a-half-head proportions. An attractive but grounded realistic fantasy game face with clearly shaped eyelids, open gray irises, a straight natural nose, defined lips, readable ears and jaw, a neutral closed mouth. Completely bald smooth scalp, no beard or facial stubble; subtle natural eyebrows only. Warm neutral light-medium skin, no tattoos or scars.
Pose and anatomy: head level and looking directly forward; arms straight approximately 35 degrees away from the sides of the torso, relaxed wrists, palms toward the viewer, exactly five anatomically correct visibly separated fingers on each empty hand. Legs straight with feet hip-width apart and toes forward. Both bare feet entirely visible and firmly on one ground plane. Bilateral symmetry suitable for rigging.
Clothing: only simple opaque matte muted charcoal-gray fitted mid-thigh modeling shorts with a flat waistband, no logos, no prominent seams, no pockets, no drawstrings. Bare torso, arms, calves and feet so joint anatomy is visible. This is a neutral technical character-design reference, not a fashion or fitness photograph.
Style/medium: polished realistic medieval fantasy game character concept render, believable anatomy and skin with slightly simplified readable forms, no exaggerated cartoon features. Prioritize detailed facial forms without waxy skin or over-sharpening; soft restrained material detail.
Composition/framing: portrait image, exactly one full-body frontal view, near-orthographic lens centered at torso height, complete scalp to soles, balanced margins around every fingertip and foot, figure occupies most of the height. Plain uniform pale warm-gray studio background, very subtle contact shadow only. Broad even neutral lighting, no dramatic cast shadows.
Constraints: one person and one view only. No hair, helmet, armor, shirt, shoes, gloves, jewelry, weapons, props, pedestal, environment, turnaround panels, face insets, lettering, logos or watermark. No heroic stance, contrapposto, bent elbows, crossed limbs or hidden fingers.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: side-view production modeling reference for a modular medieval fantasy game character.
Edit target: the attached front-view character reference.
Create a strict left-side profile view of EXACTLY THE SAME adult bald male character, facing toward the left edge of the image, preserving his face identity, skull and jaw shapes, body proportions, skin tone, moderately athletic build, opaque charcoal-gray mid-thigh shorts, bare feet, neutral expression, and the same symmetrical relaxed A-pose. Rotate the view 90 degrees around his vertical axis; do not redesign the character or change the pose. Arms remain extended diagonally away from the body in the frontal plane, so the near arm overlaps the far arm in this true profile. Preserve correct five-finger hands and human anatomy. No hair and no facial hair.
One full-body side view only, scalp to soles visible, same scale and plain pale gray studio background, near-orthographic camera, even neutral lighting, clean modeling-reference render. No front view, no three-quarter view, no additional people, no inset panels, no labels, text, props or equipment.

back_texture_repair.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: albedo texture repair reference for a 3D fantasy game character.
Input image: edit target, an unlit orthographic render of the BACK of an adult male game model wearing charcoal shorts. The head is cropped at the top.
Primary request: repair ONLY the two incorrect dark circular chest-like marks painted on the left and right shoulder-blade areas of this BACK. Replace each mark with continuous normal back skin matching the immediately surrounding warm tan skin tone and fine texture. This is the rear torso: there should be ordinary unmarked skin at both locations.
Preserve the exact square framing, pixel alignment, body outline, anatomy, A-pose, original color and skin detail everywhere else, plain gray background, shorts, arms, neck, and every edge. Do not add lighting or shadows; retain the flat unlit albedo appearance. No zoom, rotation, recropping, redesign, scars, freckles, logos, text or additional objects. Change only those two small circular surface defects and blend them seamlessly into the adjacent skin.
back_texture_repair.purpose: Correct duplicated front torso marks on the back; project only two local repair areas onto the Meshy-derived model.

method.fit: Scale X/Z displacement from the Leg-to-Foot bone centerline by 0.5 below 0.22 m, blending with smoothstep to 1.0 at 0.34 m. Transform normals with the inverse-transpose Jacobian; preserve UVs and skin weights.
method.visibility: Hide both ankle regions with pants. Without pants, show ankles for bare feet or boot_ankles with boots; hide feet with boots.

skin_surface_revision.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless diffuse albedo texture for an existing 3D male game character's skin. The attached character image is a COLOR AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Generate ONLY a flat square swatch of warm light tan human skin matching the reference's upper thigh and abdomen, evenly lit without directional lighting, very subtle fine pores and faint natural mottling. This is a surface texture tile, NOT a picture of a person or body part. Edge-to-edge uniform skin, no clothing, seams, folds, hairs, freckles, scars, limbs, anatomy, text, black borders, highlights, large blotches, or shadows. Fine pore density suitable for a 45-centimeter wide skin surface. All four edges must tile seamlessly. Low contrast, photorealistic PBR base-color swatch. Do not depict any person, pose, genitals, or body contours.
